reason: I'm not letting a bot I've never heard of sit in my staff chat and log into my Google account. My screenshots in the group work fine, I check them myself at the end of the day.
objection: A small new bot gets into my Google Drive and reads all my work chats, and in a year it may be gone or sold to someone else with my data.
would_change_my_mind: Another café owner I know using it for six months without problems, and a way to use it without giving it my whole Google account.
